config.name: Filters and Time Ranges
config.content:
Filters and time ranges
Configure tokens once; widgets that support them will scope automatically.
Global tokens
  • defaultResourceGroup — default *
  • defaultResource — typically *.logicmonitor.com
  • defaultWebsiteGroup — Websites dashboards
  • accountname — replace {{ACCOUNT_NAME}}
Time ranges
  • Status scorecards — day
  • Alert trends — 7days / 1day
  • Coverage drift — 3month
  • Collector graphs — preserve source timescales
